status.en: 12 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 50% more than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Golan Heights and Aleppo.
status.nb: 12 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 50 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Golanhøydene og Aleppo.

summary.en: ISIL suicide bombers struck security facilities in Hasakah, killing two Syrian security force members, and in Tartous, where a gunman was killed after wounding a security officer. The Syrian government is debating a law to grant nationality to children of foreign fighters, reflecting concerns about the legacy of extremist participation. Qatar, Saudi Arabia and Jordan issued condemnations of the attacks on Syrian security facilities, while Syrian authorities seized Iranian weapons destined for Lebanon, a shipment linked to the IRGC. The UCDP recorded 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: ISIL-selvmordsbomber angrep sikkerhetsanlegg i Hasakah, og drepte to medlemmer av de syriske sikkerhetsstyrkene, og i Tartous, hvor en bevæpnet mann ble drept etter å ha såret en sikkerhetsoffiser. Den syriske regjeringen diskuterer en lov som skal gi statsborgerskap til barn av utenlandske krigere, noe som gjenspeiler bekymringer om arven etter ekstremistisk deltakelse. Qatar, Saudi-Arabia og Jordan avsatte fordømmelser av angrepene på syriske sikkerhetsanlegg, mens syriske myndigheter beslagla iranske våpen på vei til Libanon, en forsendelse knyttet til IRGC. UCDP registrerte 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
